name: pboc_get_economic_indicator
description:
One Chinese economic indicator: gdp (current US dollars, annual; World Bank series on FRED), gdp_growth (real, %, annual, IMF World Economic Outlook including projections), exports, imports, trade_balance (goods, US dollars, monthly, seasonally adjusted; OECD series on FRED) or house_price_index (residential property prices, 2010=100, quarterly; BIS, on FRED).
Returns: series_code (FRED id, or IMF flow.key), series_id, label, source, observation_count and observations (date, value) oldest first, missing values dropped.
Inputs (none required): indicator (gdp, gdp_growth, exports, imports, trade_balance, house_price_index; default gdp_growth); start_date, end_date (YYYY-MM-DD); recent_periods (1-500; default 10; the last N observations, used only when neither date is given).
Ids: pboc_list_series. FRED series need FRED_API_KEY (config fred.api.key); without it they fail with a message saying so. IMF series need no key.
Example: {"indicator": "trade_balance", "start_date": "2025-01-01"}

recent_periods.description: The last N observations; used only when neither date is given
